author: Kushal
problem: a and b map each coin value in cents to how many of that coin are in a cafe's two cash drawers (every count is at least 1). Return a dict with how many of each coin there are in both drawers together.
bug_description: Uses the | operator on Counters, which keeps the larger of the two counts, instead of +, which adds them.

comments.accurate: Returns the total count of each coin across both drawers
comments.wrong_behavior: Returns each coin's count from whichever drawer holds more of it
comments.wrong_location: Counter merge verified; converting back with dict() may reorder the coin values
